story.text: 저녁을 든든히 먹고 나니, 친구가 노래방 간판을 가리켰습니다. "기장님, 오늘 목청 좀 풀어볼까요?"
story.reading: jeo-nyeog-eul deun-deun-hi meok-go na-ni, chin-gu-ga no-rae-bang gan-pan-eul ga-ri-kyeot-seum-ni-da. "gi-jang-nim, o-neul mok-cheong jom pul-eo-bol-kka-yo?"
story.en: After a hearty dinner, my friend pointed at a karaoke sign. "Captain, shall we warm up our voices tonight?"

story.text: 작은 방에 마이크 두 개가 놓였습니다. "제 '18번'부터 예약하겠습니다." 저는 진지하게 리모컨 버튼을 눌렀습니다.
story.reading: jag-eun bang-e ma-i-keu du gae-ga noh-yeot-seum-ni-da. "je 'sip-pal-beon'-bu-teo ye-yak-ha-get-seum-ni-da." jeo-neun jin-ji-ha-ge ri-mo-keon beo-teun-eul nul-leot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Two microphones sat in the small room. "I'll reserve my 'go-to song' first." I pressed the remote button with total seriousness.

story.text: 친구도 지지 않고 자신의 '애창곡'을 연달아 예약했습니다. 화면 속 예약 목록이 금세 길어졌습니다.
story.reading: chin-gu-do ji-ji an-ko ja-sin-ui 'ae-chang-gok'-eul yeon-dal-a ye-yak-haess-seum-ni-da. hwa-myeon sok ye-yak mok-log-i geum-se gil-eo-jyeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Not to be outdone, my friend reserved their own 'favorite song' one after another. The reservation list on the screen quickly grew long.

story.text: 전주가 흐르자 친구가 먼저 마이크를 잡았습니다. 저는 박수로 박자를 맞추며 대기했습니다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-ga heu-reu-ja chin-gu-ga meon-jeo ma-i-keu-reul jab-at-seum-ni-da. jeo-neun bak-su-ro bak-ja-reul mat-chu-myeo dae-gi-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As the intro played, my friend grabbed the mic first. I waited, clapping along to the beat.

story.text: 제 차례가 되자 친구가 '탬버린'을 건넸습니다. "기장님은 흔들기 담당이에요." 저는 순순히 리듬을 탔습니다.
story.reading: je cha-rye-ga doe-ja chin-gu-ga 'taem-beo-rin'-eul geon-naess-seum-ni-da. "gi-jang-nim-eun heun-deul-gi dam-dang-i-e-yo." jeo-neun sun-sun-hi ri-deum-eul tass-seum-ni-da.
story.en: When my turn came, my friend handed me a 'tambourine'. "Captain, you're on shaking duty." I obediently went along with the rhythm.

story.text: 다음 곡에서는 제가 마이크를 잡았습니다. 평소와 달리 감정을 실어 '열창'했더니, 친구가 눈을 크게 떴습니다.
story.reading: da-eum gog-e-seo-neun je-ga ma-i-keu-reul jab-at-seum-ni-da. pyeong-so-wa dal-li gam-jeong-eul sil-eo 'yeol-chang'-haess-deo-ni, chin-gu-ga nun-eul keu-ge tteot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: On the next song, I took the mic myself. Unlike usual, I sang with real emotion — I 'sang passionately' — and my friend's eyes went wide.

story.text: "방금 그 소절, '소름' 돋았어." 친구의 진심 어린 반응에, 저도 모르게 어깨가 으쓱해졌습니다.
story.reading: "bang-geum geu so-jeol, 'so-reum' dod-a-sseo." chin-gu-ui jin-sim eo-rin ban-eung-e, jeo-do mo-reu-ge eo-kkae-ga eu-sseuk-hae-jyeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "That last line just now, I got 'chills'." At my friend's sincere reaction, I couldn't help but feel a little proud.

story.text: 번쩍이는 조명 아래, 목이 다 쉬도록 노래를 불렀습니다. 그날 밤 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: beon-jjeok-i-neun jo-myeong a-rae, mog-i da swi-do-rok no-rae-reul bul-leot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal bam na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Under the flashing lights, we sang until our voices went hoarse. Let me share the conversation we had that night.

words.example_en: My go-to song is a ballad.
This song is my favorite song to sing.
My friend cheered, shaking the tambourine.

words.meaning: to sing passionately, with all one's heart
words.example_en: He closed his eyes and sang passionately.
Goosebumps rose at that high note.

sentences.en: My go-to song is always the same.
This song is my favorite song to sing.
My friend shook the tambourine excitedly.
I passionately sang the last song with all my strength.
I got goosebumps at the high note part.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 곡 번호를 입력하면 되는 겁니까? 저는 이 번호로 하겠습니다.
turns.reading: gok beon-ho-reul ib-lyeog-ha-myeon doe-neun geob-ni-kka? jeo-neun i beon-ho-ro ha-get-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: Do I just enter the song number? I'll go with this number.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 오, 그거 완전 옛날 노래잖아. 그게 너의 18번이야?
turns.reading: o, geu-geo wan-jeon yet-nal no-rae-ja-na. geu-ge neo-ui sip-pal-beon-i-ya?
turns.en: Oh, that's such an old song. Is that your go-to song?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 고등학교 때부터 즐겨 불렀습니다. 실망시키지 않겠습니다.
turns.reading: go-deung-hak-gyo ttae-bu-teo jeul-gyeo bul-leot-seum-ni-da. sil-mang-si-ki-ji an-ket-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: I've enjoyed singing it since high school. I won't disappoint you.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: I'll look forward to it, Captain!

dialogues.question: 상우의 '18번'은 언제부터 즐겨 부른 노래인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Since when has Sangwoo enjoyed singing his 'go-to song'?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 고등학교 때부터 그 노래를 즐겨 불렀다고 말했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 다음 곡은 내가 부를게. 탬버린 좀 쳐 줘.
turns.reading: da-eum gog-eun nae-ga bu-reul-ge. taem-beo-rin jom chyeo jwo.
turns.en: I'll sing the next song. Play the tambourine for me.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: Understood. I'll shake it faithfully in time with the beat.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어때, 나 열창했지? 소름 돋지 않았어?
turns.reading: eo-ttae, na yeol-chang-haet-ji? so-reum dod-ji an-ass-eo?
turns.en: How was it, I sang my heart out, right? Didn't you get chills?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 네, 솔직히 조금 놀랐습니다. 방금 그 고음, 인상적이었습니다.
turns.reading: ne, sol-jik-hi jo-geum nol-lat-seum-ni-da. bang-geum geu go-eum, in-sang-jeog-i-eot-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: Yes, honestly I was a bit surprised. That high note just now was impressive.

dialogues.question: 상우는 친구의 노래를 듣고 어떤 반응을 보였나요?
dialogues.question_en: How did Sangwoo react after hearing his friend's song?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 친구의 고음에 솔직히 놀랐다고 하면서 인상적이었다는 반응을 보였습니다.
